commits.subject: chore(governance): define Phase 09 infrastructure and homologation
fix(infra): make HTTPS proxy readiness check internal-safe
test(governance): advance active candidate fixture to Phase 09
docs(infra): refresh Phase 09 handoff after governance test fix
docs(infra): add homologation incident response procedure

delivered_scope: Phase 09 canonical manifest and active candidate based on main SHA 12b519c3e8237e1ebe43c1a0253b0747e0680e07.
Coolify-oriented homologation Compose with web, worker-default, worker-integrations, Beat, release and Redis in one stack.
PostgreSQL removed from the homologation application stack and represented only by the required external DATABASE_URL contract.
No public Redis or Celery ports; only web exposes container port 8000 for Coolify proxy ingress.
Production settings used in homologation with external effects fail-closed by default.
Environment-variable contract with placeholders only; no real credentials.
Operational runbook for Coolify topology, migrations, health, backup/restore, rollback, observability, incident response and provider subgates.

Incident response procedure covers severity classification, containment, evidence preservation, recovery/rollback decision, controlled recovery, post-incident validation, escalation and governance impact.
Foundation CI renders and validates docker-compose.homologation.yml in addition to local/test Compose definitions.
Governance orchestrator fixture updated for the active Phase 09 candidate.

tests.previous_ci: Foundation CI #206 / run 31840509618 passed on e41cacfeab38d9da35e6f344c2009ef53d960165. P09-IR-001 rework changes only docs/HOMOLOGATION.md plus governance carriers; a replacement CI is required on the new material candidate fac5e9c0d86b2137c8542d7ef4101e1746a38fab.

ci.context: Independent Review returned CHANGES_REQUESTED only for P09-IR-001. The material rework adds the required incident response procedure; replacement CI must be green before re-review.

organization_isolation.evidence: P09-IR-001 rework is documentation-only and introduces no operational entity or authorization path; cross-Organization regression remains mandatory in replacement CI.

legacy_reuse.flowlog_reference: No Flowlog runtime, database, Redis, secrets or infrastructure may be reused.

independent_review.finding: docs/HOMOLOGATION.md lacked an operational incident response procedure covering classification, containment, evidence preservation, rollback/recovery decision, post-incident validation and escalation.

deferred: real Coolify resource provisioning and runtime acceptance evidence until an external homologation environment is explicitly executed/recorded
provider sandbox activation and credentials until provider-specific authorization
risks: The external PostgreSQL resource must be reachable privately from the Coolify application stack without exposing port 5432 publicly.
Backup must be proven by restore, not only configuration, before final Phase 09 approval.
Production SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT requires internal healthchecks to represent the proxy HTTPS scheme; the homologation Compose supplies X-Forwarded-Proto=https.
Redis is intentionally ephemeral for the initial homologation stack; durable canonical state remains in PostgreSQL.
Real incident-response execution can only be evidenced after an authorized homologation environment exists; the required operational procedure is now documented.
GitHub Actions still emits the known non-blocking Node.js 20 deprecation warning while actions are forced onto Node.js 24.

human_approval.evidence: Human approved the Phase 09 plan and implementation. Independent Review revalidation, QA/Security, final Phase 09 approval, real provider activation, production release/go-live and Phase 10 remain pending.
